Questions, answered.

Do I need to be a Python developer?

No. If you can run a command in Terminal, you can use the scripts. Python 3.10+, nothing to install. Every script has --mock and --dry-run. The prompts work in any chat window without code.

Which AI provider do I need, and what does it cost?

Any OpenAI-compatible API, or a free local model in Ollama or LM Studio. A typical run usually costs well under a dollar in tokens.

Will it post replies or upload anything?

No, on purpose. Scripts write drafts to files; you publish yourself.

Is AI translation good enough to ship?

For major languages with good context it's a strong first draft. New strings are marked needs_review, placeholders and plurals are checked by code, and you get a QA checklist and a back-translation prompt.

Flutter, React Native, KMP?

The prompts and the ASO, review and release-notes scripts work for any app. Translation scripts read native .xcstrings and strings.xml; the prompts cover ARB/JSON.

What if it's not for me?

14-day refund, no questions asked. Email hello@nexauva.com.
